artifacts.name: buffalo_s
artifacts.license: InsightFace pre-trained models - non-commercial research use only
artifacts.notes: Only det_500m.onnx is taken. det_10g needs 127 ms per frame even at 320x320, which leaves nothing of the 150 ms budget for the other three models; SCRFD-500M is roughly 20x lighter. The pack's other files duplicate buffalo_l's or are lower quality, so they are left in the archive.
